api_type_boundary.integrated_direct_qnn: Reads QNN graph tensor descriptors and memcpy-copies INT64 position buffers: 1368 bytes for AR171 and 8 bytes for AR1.
api_type_boundary.non_generalization: The qnn-net-run raw-file convention is not reused or generalized to the direct-QNN runner ABI.
api_type_boundary.prior_qnn_net_run: The accepted qnn-net-run input-file route separately used INT32 raw position files through qnn-net-run's file population/conversion boundary, while execution metadata reported QNN INT64 tensors.

claim_boundary: Host static/build/stage readiness only; no integrated physical execution, TTFT, performance distribution, campaign, or registry result.
fidelity_boundary: Severe retained physical AR171 state drift and token-5 reference divergence remain; integrated operability cannot establish numerical or output fidelity.
host_runtime_boundary: Host and Android binaries compile. No integrated inference ran: x86 AR171 execution already exceeds 1800 seconds, so repeating it is intentionally excluded.

integrated_semantics.finite_scan: all requested outputs before copying: 60 for AR171 and 60 for every AR1 decode call
integrated_semantics.output_cap_semantics: MAX_NEW is total emitted tokens including the AR171 endpoint; max16 performs at most 15 AR1 calls and stops early on EOS
integrated_semantics.output_persistence: exclusive output file opened before backend setup; endpoint and every decode token appended and fsync'd immediately, preserving partial output on later inference/finite-scan/profile failure
integrated_semantics.profile: detailed recursive QNN events phase-labeled; extraction is optional/fail-open and explicitly logged; prefill profile freed/reset before AR1 load
integrated_semantics.timing: backend setup is separate. Actual request-start to first emitted token includes its fsync and excludes later profile work. Actual request-start to final emitted token includes the intervening prefill profile dump, context free, profile reset, AR1 context load, and token fsyncs, but excludes the trailing AR1 profile dump/free. Compute-only phase sums and diagnostic total including all profile/free overhead are separately labeled.

phone_boundary: No ADB or phone access occurred. Stage and runner script are readiness evidence only.

proposed_phone_gate.scope: one exact canonical-short/max16 integrated process; preserve raw tokens and phase-labeled detailed profile logs before validation
proposed_phone_gate.success_boundary: finite-scanned completion and coherent bounded tokens; reference or numerical equality is not required

shared_context_assessment.ordinary_two_graph_context: No verified ORT/QAIRT path here aliases constants across two ordinary static-shape graphs; current ordinary contexts each report sharedWeightsSize=0 and would duplicate about 3.19 GB constants.
shared_context_assessment.possible_future_work: A custom Qualcomm-supported multi-graph context with proven cross-graph constant aliasing would require new SDK documentation or maintainer guidance and fresh host/physical evidence.
shared_context_assessment.shared_weight_format: ORT shared multi-graph generation uses the previously rejected shared-weight resource format. x86 rejected its shared weights and physical matched-runtime context creation failed. It is not revived as a candidate.
shared_context_assessment.single_graph_selector: A single ordinary static graph cannot select AR171 versus AR1 shape/semantics without executing duplicate branches or relying on unsupported dynamic control flow.
